title: A Culture Method to Maintain Quiescent Human Hematopoietic Stem Cells
protocol: Dissolve sodium palmitate in methanol at a concentration of 16 mg/mL.
Dissolve sodium oleate in methanol at a concentration of 30 mg/mL.
Dissolve cholesterol in methanol at a concentration of 4 mg/mL.
Store the lipid solutions at -30°C and thaw before use.
Mix lipid solutions prepared previously to obtain final concentrations: 100 µg/ml palmitate, 100 µg/ml oleate, and 20 µg/ml cholesterol in fresh glass tubes.
Evaporate methanol from the mixed lipid solution by passing nitrogen gas through it.
If nitrogen gas is not available, pass air through the solution using a pipette-aid to evaporate remaining methanol.
Completely evaporate any residual methanol by heating the glass tube containing lipids at 37°C in a water bath.
Prepare Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium (DMEM)/F12 medium (with HEPES and glutamine).
Add penicillin and streptomycin sulfate to the DMEM/F12 medium to achieve final concentrations of 50 units/mL and 50 μg/mL, respectively.
Store DMEM/F12 medium containing antibiotics at 4°C for up to 2 months.
Add 4% w/v bovine serum albumin (BSA) to DMEM/F12 medium (with HEPES and glutamine).
Adjust the pH of the medium to 7.4-7.8 using NaOH solution, typically targeting a pH of 7.6.
Add the prepared medium to glass tubes as needed.
Sonicate the mixture for at least 20 minutes to completely dissolve lipids.
Store the dissolved sample at -80°C and use within 2 months.
Mix 1/1,000 of the insulin, transferrin, sodium selenite, and ethanol amine (ITS-X) mixture into DMEM/F12.
Filter the mixed medium using a 0.22 µm filter to obtain culture media.
Add human stem cell factor (SCF) and human thrombopoietin (TPO) to the culture media at a final concentration of 3 ng/mL each.
Do not store the medium after adding cytokines and ITS-X.
Mix 10% FCS with Ca- and Mg-free phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) to prepare staining buffer.
Store the staining buffer at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.
Mix 10% FCS into DMEM/F12 to prepare thawing media.
This solution is single-use only.
Dissolve human SCF or human TPO in PBS (Ca- and Mg-free) at a concentration of 20 µg/mL to create cytokine stock solutions.
Store the cytokine stock solutions at -80 °C for up to one year without loss of activity.
Once thawed, store the stock solution at 4 °C and use within 1 month.
Purchase human CD34+ bone marrow cells.
Store the cells in liquid nitrogen until use.
Warm 10 mL of thawing media in a 15 mL conical tube in a 37 °C water bath.
Thaw the frozen cells in vials in a 37 °C water bath within 2 min.
Wipe the vial with 70% ethanol to remove contaminants.
Transfer the cells to the 15 mL tube containing pre-warmed medium from step 3.2.
Centrifuge the 15 mL tube at 200 × g for 15 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully to keep the pellet intact (leaving < 50 µL of medium).
Resuspend the cells with the remaining medium.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a 1.5 mL tube on ice.
Label the cells with fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies.
Mix 50 µL of staining buffer plus 10 µL of anti-CD34-FITC, 2 µL of anti-CD38-PerCP-Cy5.5, 5 µL of anti-CD90-PE-Cy7, and 10 µL of anti-CD45RA-PE.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the antibody mixture.
Incubate the cells for 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.
Add 1 mL of staining buffer to wash the antibodies.
Centrifuge the tubes at 340 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.5 mL of staining buffer + 0.1% propidium iodide.
Transfer the suspension into a 5 mL tube using a 40 µm filter.
Gate the phenotypic HSCs within the PI-CD34+CD38-CD90+CD45RA- fraction using the FACS Aria-IIIu and sort the cells into a 1.5 mL tube filled with 500 µL of culture media.
Centrifuge the sorted cells at 340 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant to ensure that the pellet remains intact.
Store the sorted cells on ice until culture.
Transfer 200 µL of cytokine-containing culture media into flat-bottom 96-well plates.
Fill unused wells with 100-200 µL of PBS to prevent evaporation.
Resuspend sorted HSCs in culture media without cytokines at a concentration of 60 cells/µL.
Aliquot 600 HSCs/well (10 µL cell suspension) into each well.
Culture the cells in a humidified multi-gas incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 and 1% O2.
Replace half of the media volume every 3-4 days for cultures over 7 days.
Carefully aspirate 100 µL of media by pipetting.
Add 100 µL of pre-warmed (at 37 °C) culture media containing cytokines to each well.
Discard 170 µL of the medium by using an 8-channel pipette.
Mix 0.5 µL of anti-CD34-FITC, 0.1 µL of anti-CD38-PerCP-Cy5.5, 0.25 µL of anti-CD90-PE-Cy7, 0.5 µL of anti-CD45RA-PE, and 9 µL of staining buffer per well.
Add 10 µL of the mixture to the 96-well plate.
Incubate the cells for 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.
Add 100 µL of staining buffer to the wells.
Centrifuge the plates at 400 × g for 5 min at 4 °C using low acceleration and medium deceleration.
Carefully aspirate 100 µL of the supernatant to maintain the cells on the bottom of the wells.
Resuspend the cells in 200 µL of staining buffer + 0.1% v/v of PI + 1% v/v of fluorescent microspheres (e.g., Flow-Check Fluorospheres).
Set up the flow cytometry instrument.
Acquire data for the samples in fast mode with mixed sample mode on and uptake volumes of 100 µL.
Export the data in FCS format and analyze it using software such as FlowJo.
Transplant human HSCs into immunodeficient NOD-SCID-Il2rg-null (NOG) mice.
Prepare a sufficient number of 8-12-week-old NOG mice as donors.
Keep breeding cages clean and feed mice with sterilized diet and water.
Culture an adequate number of HSCs for transplantation.
Irradiate NOG mice at 2.5 Gy at 6-24 hours prior to transplantation.
Collect the cultured HSCs in 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes at 340 ×g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatants carefully and resuspend cells in sterile ice-cold staining buffer.
Filter the staining buffer using a 0.22 µm filter to sterilize it.
Anesthetize the mice by sevoflurane or isoflurane inhalation before transplantation.
Transplant 5000 cultured HSCs into the tail vein or retro-orbital sinus of NOG mice using a 1 mL syringe and 27-gauge needle.
Anesthetize mice by sevoflurane inhalation before collecting peripheral blood.
Collect 40-80 μL of peripheral blood from the retro-orbital sinus using heparinized glass capillary tubes.
Suspend collected blood in 1 mL of PBS + heparin (1 U/mL) in 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge blood suspension at 340 × g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL of PBS + 1.2% w/v dextran (200 kDa).
Incubate the sample at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Transfer supernatant to another 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at 340 × g for 3 min.
Resuspend cells in 0.17 M NH4Cl for red blood cell lysis.
Incubate the cell suspension at 4 °C for 5 min.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 340 × g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL of staining buffer containing 0.3 μL of anti-mouse Fc-block.
Incubate the sample at 4 °C for 5 min.
Add 0.3 μL of mouse CD45-PE-Cy7 antibody.
Add 0.3 μL of mouse Ter-119-PE-Cy7 antibody.
Add 0.3 μL of human CD45-BV421 antibody.
Add 0.3 μL of human CD13-PE antibody.
Add 1.2 μL of human CD33-PE antibody.
Add 0.3 μL of human CD19-APC antibody.
Add 0.3 μL of human CD3-APC-Cy7 antibody.
Incubate the cells at 4 °C for 15 min.
Wash the cells once with 1 mL of staining buffer.
Centrifuge the cells at 340 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of staining buffer + 0.1% v/v of PI.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 96-well flat-bottom plate.
Acquire data using the flow cytometer in fast mode with the mix sample mode on and an uptake volume of 100 µL.
Export the data in FCS format for analysis using software such as FlowJo.
